name: mibi-adult-S13-b
refs: The adult of this species (project-owned rig render): its body plan, proportions and colours only, a crude 3D blockout to be painted over: a beetle: a long rounded green body with darker armour, six short legs, a dark head with two long thin antennae.
The species' signed silhouette (project-owned): the adult's outline.
prompt: Paint the ADULT of the creature in the references: a beetle with a long rounded green body under darker armoured plates, six legs and a dark head with two long thin antennae. Keep its body plan, proportions and colours, but NOT the blockout's geometry. The legs are slim, jointed insect legs with small round feet, never slabs or blocks. It has a FACE: two large round dark glossy eyes with a pale highlight on the front of the dark head, a small calm mouth, and the antennae rising from above the eyes. This is the species' BARE BASE picture: the wing cases are SHORT and CLOSED, lying flat and shut over the back, never parted or raised, no wings showing. Soft, rounded, living forms. Matte painterly rendering like a children's book, smooth painted forms, gentle shading, light from the top left, a soft flat contact shadow beneath it. Three-quarter view from the front left, facing the viewer, calm, standing at rest. One creature, centred, large, on a plain flat solid magenta (#FF00FF) background with nothing else. No outline glow, no text, no ground, no props, no people. Never childish: a grown animal, not a baby.
